Audience: every first-time South Carolina Class D applicant; parking and passing procedures also matter on the skills test.
Why it matters to a first-timer: when a driver may keep going past a stopped school bus, and when they must wait, is settled here [A01], along with the wheel positions for parking on a hill [A04].
Level: a mix of exact values (curb distance, passing signal distance, the school bus road definition) and step-by-step procedures for parking and passing.
Prerequisites: the school bus rules, turning and backing skills from the previous sections, which this section continues.
